deviceType: Reduced pressure principle assembly — large-body relief valve service
title: Wilkins 375 large-body relief valve repair kits: 2 1/2–10 inch
description: Use the manufacturer-published repair-kit map for the large-body relief valve in Zurn Wilkins 375, 375A, 375AST, 475, and 475V assemblies from 2 1/2 through 10 inches.
summary: This record is intentionally limited to the large-body relief valve. Zurn publishes a different component set for 2 1/2–6 inch versus 8–10 inch assemblies, and neither should be treated as a universal 375 kit.
statusNote: This is not a substitute for the 1 1/4–2 inch 375 repair path, check-service kits, valve configuration, or a diagnosis of continuous relief discharge. Confirm the exact size and repair scope before ordering.
diagramAlt: Reduced pressure backflow assembly showing the central relief-valve zone between check assemblies
identifiers: Use this record only when the assembly is a Zurn Wilkins 375-family large-body unit and the required work is specifically the relief-valve service path.
The 2 1/2–6 inch and 8–10 inch relief-valve kits have separate part-number prefixes and must not be swapped.
A relief-valve kit is not a diagnosis: continuous discharge can involve check, pressure, debris, or installation conditions that require qualified testing.

kits.contents: Published relief-valve rubber and service components including diaphragm, seal rings, relief spring, and related O-rings.
kits.compatibility: For the manufacturer-published 2 1/2–6 inch relief-valve path in Models 375, 375A, 375AST, 475, and 475V.

kits.contents: Published rubber service components for the relief-valve assembly.
kits.compatibility: Rubber-only scope; does not include the complete relief-valve internal component set.

kits.contents: Upper and lower plunger, diaphragm, seals, seat, retainer, washer, bolt, and relief-valve spring in the published component matrix.
kits.compatibility: For the 2 1/2–6 inch relief-valve path; confirm the exact assembly before internal disassembly.

kits.contents: Relief-valve cover and published cover hardware.
kits.compatibility: Cover scope only; does not replace the relief-valve internal service kit.

kits.contents: Published upper and lower plunger service components.
kits.compatibility: Plunger scope only; compare against diaphragm, seat, and seal condition.

kits.contents: Published relief-valve rubber and service components for the 8 and 10 inch size band.
kits.compatibility: For the manufacturer-published 8 and 10 inch relief-valve path in Models 375, 375A, 375AST, 475, and 475V.

kits.contents: Published rubber service components for the large 8 and 10 inch relief-valve assembly.
kits.compatibility: Rubber-only scope; it does not include the complete relief-valve internal component set.

kits.contents: Published upper and lower plunger, diaphragm, seals, seat, retainer, washer, bolt, and relief-valve spring components.
kits.compatibility: Use only for the 8 and 10 inch relief-valve service path.

kits.contents: Relief-valve cover and published cover hardware.
kits.compatibility: Cover scope only; does not substitute for internals or rubber service.
